questionEn: What is characteristic specifically of “simple substances”, and not of a related concept?
questionUz: O'zaro bog'liq tushunchaga emas, balki "oddiy moddalar" ga nima xosdir?
choicesEn: substances consisting of atoms of the same element
substances consisting of atoms of various elements
the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element
changes in the shape of an element that differs from each other in physical and chemical properties
choicesUz: bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar
bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi
fizik va kimyoviy xossalari bilan bir-biridan farq qiluvchi element shaklining o'zgarishi
explanationEn: Simple substances are substances consisting of atoms of the same element.
explanationUz: Oddiy moddalar - bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar.
